title: ProtocolSchema
description: Collect every public wire type in one authoritative JSON Schema.

AdmissionPolicy.description: Queue policy chosen by the owner, never by generated agent content.

oneOf.description: Fill spare capacity while bounding bypass of an older session head.

CapacityMode.description: Capacity policy belongs to the local owner, never to generated content.

CapacityPolicy.description: Optional values are explicit hard ceilings. Omission is not a zero budget.

CapacitySnapshot.description: A cheap cached snapshot. Reading it performs no probes or control work.

capacity.description: Omission preserves the original fixed, process-local configuration.

EventPage.description: Bounded replay through a captured global high-water boundary.

cursor.description: Global boundary represented by this page, or `through` when complete.

omitted.description: The next single event exceeds the byte budget. Take a fresh snapshot.

selected_cursor.description: Last represented selected-session sequence, if this page returned one.

descriptor_limit.description: The soft per-process file-descriptor limit, never a shared host budget.

domain_visibility.description: Unsupported or incomplete ancestor visibility prevents safe growth.

process_limit.description: The soft Unix per-user process limit; it is not free process capacity.

NativeHelperSnapshot.description: Cached coarse helper commitments. Counts include pending and draining owners.

processes.description: Process slots, including the helper runtime's threads on Linux.

NativeOperation.description: An epoch and monotonic operation number. It never authorizes a replay.

NativeSnapshot.description: A cached view. Reading it never starts a helper or performs I/O.

owner_deaths.description: Confirmed owner deaths observed by this handle. This is not a job ledger.

owner_pid.description: Last authenticated owner PID. This cached value does not establish liveness.

Observation.description: Missing values and stale samples remain distinct from a measured zero.

Observation2.description: Missing values and stale samples remain distinct from a measured zero.

Observation3.description: Missing values and stale samples remain distinct from a measured zero.

OperatingSnapshot.description: Bounded local state, separate from the legacy [`GovernorSnapshot`] shape.

contact_valid.description: False after the cached coordination contact deadline expires.

memory_leases.description: Contexts and persistent hosts reserve memory without active job slots.

OperatingTarget.description:
Adjustable budgets beneath the governor's immutable hard limits.

Zero is valid and parks admission for that resource. Shrinking a target does
not revoke running leases or erase reservations that exceed the new target.

PackageGrants.description: Host-owned registration allowlists. They do not sandbox trusted native code.

ProviderQuotaConfig.description: Owner-supplied quota identity. Never derive this UUID from credentials.

ProviderRate.description:
A locally configured sustained rate. Known rate charges are not concurrency
slots and survive local cancellation until their window expires.

ResourceDomainObservation.description: Visible ancestor constraints. IDs contain native scope identities, not paths.

ResourceLimits.description: Aggregate admission budgets shared by every session and executor.

RestrictionState.description: `Monitored` is observation and reactive cleanup, not a hard OS ceiling.

SchedulingSnapshot.description:
Cached local run counts. Each managed run occupies at most one listed phase.

These counts describe engine work, not OS CPU use, native child liveness, or
a host-wide total. Reading them performs no journal or host observation I/O.

managed_runs.description: Runs retained by the engine, including waiting and finishing runs.

model_preparing.description: Runs preparing admitted context, hooks and a provider request.

model_running.description: Runs inside a provider callback, including streamed-output backpressure.

model_waiting.description: Runs waiting for a model slot, coordinated model credit or context memory.

provider_waiting.description: Runs waiting for provider selection or coordinated provider quota.

runnable_runs.description:
Managed runs outside the explicit waiting, preparation and service phases.
This includes journal and hook work; it is not an OS runnable-thread count.

tool_dispatch_waiting.description: Runs waiting to enter the bounded tool-dispatch pool.

tool_resource_waiting.description: Runs waiting for a tool reservation in the shared governor.

tool_running.description:
Runs inside a tool callback. Self-admitting tools may wait internally.
Callback completion does not prove that uncertain native work has exited.

workspace_waiting.description: Runs waiting for their workspace mutation lock.

SessionCursor.description: Stable continuation for a session query. Keep it with the same query.

SessionPage.description: A page in descending creation-time and identity order.

SessionQuery.description: Case-insensitive title or identity prefix search, with bounded pages.

SessionRunTransition.description: The latest committed run transition, independent of the visible tail.

SessionTailOptions.description:
Hard payload bounds for a presentation tail or replay page.

Zero in either field requests an authority-only tail. Replay pages require
positive bounds.
At most 1000 events and 2 MiB of serialized event payload are returned.

SessionView.description: One consistent journal boundary for authority and bounded presentation.

durable_cursor.description: Global durable high-water sequence at this snapshot.

run_id.description: The active run only. Finished identity is in `last_transition`.

selected_cursor.description: Last selected-session sequence, matching live predecessor tokens.

cached_input_tokens.description: Reported subset of input tokens served from the provider's cache.

reasoning_output_tokens.description: Reported subset of output tokens spent on reasoning.
